body_html: COMPLETELY FLAWLESS SHOW TONIGHT!!! This is what all work should be like (if you can call it work)! Getting paid to have FUN and play some JAMMIN MUSIC! We had a huge MIX of people from young to young at heart, leading to the MOST VAST VARIETY of REQUESTS EVER!!! I had a blast trying to mix everything from Rob Zombie to Chris Brown without losing the MOMENTUM that was created early on!! I had so much fun, I can’t describe the EXCITEMENT I have for NEXT WEEK!! COME ON DOWN TO PLATTE RIVER BAR & GRILL ON SANTA FE, FRIDAY NIGHT AND FILL UP ON ENERGY THAT WE PROVIDE FREE OF CHARGE!!!!
